library_delta: The fork commit adds an optional example, its CI, and documentation. src/ and build.rs match the previously reviewed upstream revision exactly.
consumption: Pinned Git dependency; no vendor source copy or local patches. Cargo retains the fork source and license files in its dependency checkout.
selected_target: redb library with std; omdb_lanes example and experimental-api-5 are not enabled by Rit.
transitive_runtime_dependency: libc 0.2.189, already present in the root lock
integration_scope: Explicit repository snapshot catalog metadata; Git objects and refs remain in the native Git store.
constraints: No custom StorageBackend or cloud durability claim.
No no_std, bare-metal, distributed writer, or Wasmtime qualification.
No automatic opening or migration of archived database prototypes.
